name: SHA-256 checksums
description: Verifies .sha256 sidecar files against the package they belong to.

codes.sha256_postprocess.mismatch: A file did not match its recorded SHA-256.
codes.sha256_postprocess.missing: None of the files a SHA-256 checksum file names is in the package.
codes.sha256_postprocess.empty: A SHA-256 checksum file lists no checksum that could be read.
codes.sha256_postprocess.unchecked: SHA-256 checksums matched, but {count} listed file(s) are not in this package and were not checked: {files}
